The '''Niran system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Tunka sector/Legends|Tunka sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. One [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in this system was [[Niran]].
